content: आम्नायः [आ-म्ना-घञ्] .²1 .³({%a%}) Sacred tradition, sacred texts handed down by tradition or repetition. .³({%b%}) Hence, the Veda, Vedas taken collectively (including Brāhmaṇas, Upaniṣads and Āraṇyakas also); अधीती चतुर्ष्वाम्नायेषु <ls>Dk. 120</ls>; आम्नायवचनं सत्यमित्ययं लोकसंग्रहः . आम्नायेभ्यः पुनर्वेदाः प्रसृताः सर्वतोमुखाः .. <ls>Mb.</ls>; <ls>Ki. 11. 39</ls>. .²2 Study (by repetition); अनाम्नायमला वेदा ब्राह्मणस्याव्रतं मलम् <ls>Mb. 12. 328. 20</ls>. .²3 A sacred text or precept in general; आम्नायादन्यत्र नूतनश्छन्दसामवतारः <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²4 Traditional usage, family or national customs; <ls>U. 6</ls>. .²5 Received doctrine. .²6 Advice or instruction (in past and present usage). .²7 A Tantra. .²8 A series of families.
